triangle_geometry: Equilateral, measured between vertex centers (or path vertices without nodes). Derive height as side * sqrt(3) / 2; do not snap derived coordinates. Font outlines are quantized to units_per_em.

proportion_guides.note: The golden divisions of a 32-unit cell are approximately 12.22 and 19.78. Snap to the integer grid when useful, except derived equilateral geometry. Triangle edges use 60-degree angles. Two-unit clear gaps and axial strokes are design-review targets, not universal constraints on curved or joined glyphs.

semantic_constraints: A glyph is a learned name, not a proof or an instance of its referent.
Reuse may suggest a family but does not establish ontological inclusion or entailment.
Do not distinguish semantically opposed terms solely by scale, rotation, or a tiny dot.
Test related marks at actual text sizes; unequal outlines alone do not establish perceptual distinctness.
